title_sq: Ne Astir, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Hapesira Te Bollshme!!!
description_sq: Ne Astir, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Hapesira Te Bollshme!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 7 nje pallati 8-katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor dhe organizohet nga korridori shperndares salloni i ndenjes me dalje ne ballkon, kendi i gatimit i vecuar, dy dhomat e gjumit, njera dhoma me dalje ne ballkon te dedikuar dhe tualeti. Apartamenti eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per banim edhe per investim pasi zona ofron te gjithe facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In Astir, 2+1 apartment with ample space for sale!!!
description_en: In Astir, 2+1 apartment with ample space for sale!!! The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a well-managed 8-story building with an elevator and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with access to the balcony, a separate kitchen, two bedrooms, one room with access to a dedicated balcony and a toilet. The apartment is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment, as the area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. The property has full mortgage documentation.
